author: Facundo Firmenich

claims.claim: Exact rational maps, primitive coordinates and local reduction factors
claims.scope: All natural bases; stated positivity and primitive-coordinate hypotheses; open high interval.

claims.claim: Integral content, chronological lifts and cycle spectrum
claims.scope: Integral 2x2 matrices with the stated primitive/nonzero hypotheses; actual high closed paths of any finite length.

claims.claim: Two-chart cycle balance and partial strict-cycle exclusions
claims.scope: Every high rational cycle; letter-count bound; no strict cycle of length <=3 or of the displayed T^a S^b form. General four-state exclusion is not formalized.

claims.claim: Two nonpermutation five-state families and their exact defects
claims.scope: Both displayed carriers and every base B0+t*M with t a natural number; five distinct high rational states, ten edges, strong connectivity, S noninjective, single strict factor r. No minimality or complete-CRT necessity claim.

claims.claim: Exactly36 induced actions and minimum rank2
claims.scope: Arbitrary finite words on both entire realized base families. Closure plus generation, not a word-length cutoff.

claims.claim: Sound square and modular filters from the original two conics
claims.scope: Integer coefficients, rational q,s with q !=0, any positive modulus; W=0 and U=0 branches included. No coverage proof for an external enumerator or execution.
